subject: Vendor master sync + onboarding kickoff: action items for ACME Supplies
messages:
From: Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@acme-supplies.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding - ACME vendor master data issues (bank+address+duplicate)

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We started the vendor onboarding for Acme Supplies but ran into a couple of blockers in your vendor master that are preventing PO issuance and initial payment setup. Summary: 

- Wrong remit address on file (it lists ACME Logistics in AZ; legal address is 1201 Harbor Way, Suite 600, Redwood City, CA).
- Duplicate supplier record: looks like there are two supplier IDs (V-8892 / V-4511) both tied to the same EIN and different bank details; payments are being routed to the wrong account.
- Bank mandate: our finance team needs the bank mandate signed and the last 4 of the routing number to validate the payee.

I attached the completed vendor onboarding form, the bank mandate, and a short PO routing doc. Can you confirm next steps and who will own the vendor-master corrections on your side? We need a corrected vendor ID before we can accept a PO against the new account.

Appreciate the help.

—Janelle Morris
Vendor Ops | Acme Supplies, Inc.
attachments: ACME_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), Bank_Details_Mandate.pdf (pdf), PO_Routing_Instructions.docx (docx)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding - ACME vendor master data issues (bank+address+duplicate)

Thanks Janelle — good summary. Monica / Dev, looping you both in to own the corrective work. High-level asks below; please confirm ETA and when we can expect the new vendor ID so Acme can proceed with PO.

Action items for Redwood (Monica, Dev):
- Validate Acme's legal name + EIN and merge duplicate records (V-8892 / V-4511) into a single canonical vendor.
- Update remit address to: "Acme Supplies, Inc., 1201 Harbor Way, Suite 600, Redwood City, CA 94063".
- Verify bank mandate and confirm last 4 routing digits that match our vault entry; if mismatch, flag for payments team and place hold.
- Confirm whether tax forms are on file (W-9 equivalent) and add to vendor record.

Janelle: once Monica/Dev confirm the vendor ID and bank verification status we will reissue the PO and share the PO number + routing instructions. If we need DocuSign for the bank mandate let me know and I’ll route it.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships (interim) | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@acme-supplies.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We started the vendor onboarding...

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding - ACME vendor master data issues (bank+address+duplicate)

Thanks — I reviewed the attachments and did an initial check in the vendor master. Notes: 

- There are indeed two records. V-8892 is the older record created in 2023; V-4511 is a duplicate created during a CSV import. Both point to EIN 94-1234567.
- The remit address currently on V-8892 is wrong (points to a distribution center). I have the corrected legal address from the submitted onboarding form; pulling it into the canonical record.
- Bank account on file for V-4511 does not match the signed mandate PDF. The mandate lists routing ending in 4321; our vault entry currently ends in 2210. We need Dev/Finance to triage before switching payment routing.

Planned steps (internal):
1) Freeze V-4511 for payments (temp hold) so no funds are misrouted.
2) Create a merge plan to consolidate V-4511 -> V-8892 and set the canonical vendor to V-8892.
3) Update remit/legal address and attach onboarding form & signed W-9 to the record.
4) Dev/Finance to validate bank mandate against vault; if mismatch, request DocuSign re-sign or bank letter.

Dev — can you take on the vault validation + apply the payment hold? I estimate I can have the canonical record ready to go by EOD today after your validation.

Monica Patel
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
attachments: ACME_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Onboarding - ACME vendor master data issues (bank+address+duplicate)

Update for the thread — completed the backend changes and left notes in the vendor record. Summary: 

- Merged V-4511 into V-8892. New canonical vendor ID: V-8892. Merge log attached to the record.
- Updated remit/legal address to: 1201 Harbor Way, Suite 600, Redwood City, CA 94063.
- Applied payment hold on the previous bank entry pending finance verification.
- Validated the bank mandate PDF: the last 4 digits provided (4321) do not match the vault entry (2210). Finance will follow up separately; I created a ticket: FIN-6378.
- Attached the PO_Routing_Instructions.docx to the vendor record and left a comment: "Reissue PO to V-8892 once finance confirms bank verification; if not verified, instruct Acme to re-sign bank mandate via DocuSign."

Janelle — from our side the vendor is consolidated and ready for PO issuance as soon as finance clears the bank. We can reissue the PO and set a one-time check payment if that speeds first invoice. Please confirm how Acme prefers to receive the PO (email to procurement@acme-supplies.com or upload to vendor portal).

Ticket links: https://app.redwood.ai/tickets/FIN-6378
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/92341

Thanks —
